title: Vectors: DAO prefix-authorization allow/deny matrix (cross-impl)
description: Repo rule: every packet format / cross-impl decision needs canonical vectors in test/vectors/. Add e.g. test/vectors/dao_prefix_authorization.json pinning the literal matrix: self /128 allow; foreign host route (/128 != origin) deny; /0 deny; undelegated broad prefix (e.g. /64) deny; delegated prefix allow (exact delegation, node-owned E=0); external E=1 with delegation allow only if delegation names external; expired delegation deny; wrong-origin delegation deny. Each vector: signed DAO wire bytes (Schnorr48 DAO Origin Signature per spec 8.6, origin pubkey, origin_sequence), root state (delegation table seed), expected outcome + rejection reason. Consumers: Rust DaoManager::process_signature_verified, Python dao_manager.validate_and_process_dao_wire_at, C process_dao (once foreign-host-route + origin binding land). Independent oracle: vectors computed once from the spec rules with the Python reference crypto, then hardcoded - never from the implementation under test. Decomposed from project-LICHEN-2auf.44.9.2.
